title: Full faithfulness of the concrete geometric-point functor
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], Ksep a separable closure, and G=Gal(Ksep/K) with its Krull topology. For etale K-schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism], let P be the functor taking X to the continuous discrete G-set Hom_K(Spec Ksep,X), whose action is constructed in [lem-exc-etale-field-geometric-action-continuous], and taking a map to postcomposition. Then P is full and faithful: every equivariant map P(X)->P(Y) comes from a unique K-morphism X->Y.

source.place: Tag 03QR, Lemma lemma-sheaves-point; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QR; full-faithfulness part of the equivalence, using finite-spectrum Galois classification

proof.text: Use the S=Spec K specialization of the fibre decomposition [lem-weil-pbc-etale-fibre-discrete-separable-points], and the canonical identification with the fibre over the unique point of Spec K, to write each etale K-scheme as the disjoint union of singleton open spectra of finite separable extensions of K. Geometric points of the coproduct factor through a unique component.

The embedding G-set on each source component is nonempty and transitive by [lem-exc-etale-field-galois-classification]. Hence an equivariant map takes it into exactly one target orbit. That node gives a bijection between equivariant maps of these embedding sets and K-morphisms of the corresponding spectra.

Assemble the unique component maps by the coproduct universal property. Their geometric-point maps are the prescribed equivariant map, proving fullness. Any two K-morphisms with the same geometric-point map coincide on every component by the same finite-spectrum Hom-bijection, hence coincide by the coproduct universal property, proving faithfulness. The argument also covers empty coproducts.
